english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being liable or predisposed to an unwanted result, as in prone to failure.

exampleSentences.english: This old phone is prone to breaking down.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 jung4 ji6 waai6 gaa3

english.note: Use this pattern when someone or something is liable or prone to do what follows the verb.

exampleSentences.english: In winter, the windows are apt to fog up.
exampleSentences.jyutping: dung1 tin1 di1 bo1 lei1 jung4 ji6 hei2 mou6
